findings: The baseline RGB key leaves a conspicuous green fringe around the muzzle and whiskers. The displayed despill pass reduces that green; residual yellow-green fringe remains visible, and dark or gray edge residue may remain; this is not a perfect key. Despill changes RGB but preserves the baseline alpha exactly. The dark nose is visible in the frame-000 crops below; this is not certification of every whisker or anatomical feature. The earlier white-background and new green-background clips are different generated samples, not a controlled proof that background color alone caused any change. Key: sampled native border RGB (0,209,0), FFmpeg colorkey similarity 0.08, blend 0.12; then despill type=green, mix=1, expand=0, green=-1, alpha=0. All 25 native samples are retained at 24fps; no loop repair.
